description: A rustic yet curated living room corner photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, composed as a three-quarter corner shot showing a rounded drum-shaped side table against a dramatic stone wall. The right edge of the frame shows the arm and cushion of a cream-linen upholstered sofa with a dark chocolate brown suede throw pillow. A warm ambient glow softens the stone wall surface and pools across the walnut tabletop. The overall palette combines warm stone, rich walnut brown, deep chocolate, and vivid orange-red botanical accents. The mood is lived-in and ruggedly warm — an American lodge aesthetic.
